reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for generating mathematical animations and videos with Manim through parameterized templates or validated scene code.

summaries.zh: 通过参数化数学模板或经静态校验的 Manim 场景代码生成数学动画视频。
summaries.en: Generates mathematical animation videos through parameterized templates or statically validated Manim scene code.

capabilities: Generates mathematical animation videos from parameterized templates
Renders user- or model-provided Manim scene code through a Python subprocess
Performs AST-based validation of generated Python code
Writes rendered media and intermediate outputs to local directories
